{{Quote|You were attacked, Warmaster? We will avenge you. Take my life as offering, and make it certain.|The warrior, to Warmaster Tsavong Lah|<ref name="BP" />}}
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''warrior''' took part in his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The [[Warrior caste|warrior]] willingly [[Death/Legends|gave up his life]] to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] after his superior was bested in a duel  with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], to sate the warmaster's fury at humiliation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|All glory to you, warrior.|Tsavong Lah, after killing the warrior|<ref name="BP" />}}
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] from the [[warrior caste]] participated in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in which his [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="BP" /> invaded the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;controlled [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] was part of a Yuuzhan Vong contingent that [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] the New Republic&ndash;allied [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. After the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] dome of [[Gateway]] was captured on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, the Yuuzhan Vong warrior and two others were tasked with guarding the building that contained the office of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], the former [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of captured Gateway, where [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] had taken up temporary residence.<ref name="BP" />

[[File:TsavongLah-FF109.png|thumb|left|200px|Tsavong Lah killed the warrior on Duros.]]
Lah [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Organa Solo in that building and was subsequently attacked by her son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], so that he could rescue her from captivity. In the fight, Lah was thrown out of the [[Window/Legends|window]] of Organa Solo's office after being hit by a whirlwind of objects, which the young Solo [[Telekinesis/Legends|created]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; Solo and his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] then fled the scene. The warrior guarding the building's exterior, along with his other two companions, witnessed the event and quickly came to the warmaster's side. While the other two averted their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] so as to not witness the humiliation of their superior, whose [[Limb/Legends|leg]] had been mangled, the warrior declared that Lah would be avenged.<ref name="BP" />

Offering his life so that the warmaster could fulfill his act of revenge, the guard knelt, and Lah struck him with the warmaster's [[Baton/Legends|baton]]. Lah [[Death/Legends|killed]] the warrior, taking out on the guard his anger at his humiliation. The warmaster then had the guard's two companions dispose the warrior's body in the [[Fire/Legends|fire]] pit that the Yuuzhan Vong had created in the center of Gateway.<ref name="BP" />

==Personality and traits==
After the warmaster was shamed, the Yuuzhan Vong guard was willing to lay down his life so that Lah could relieve his fury. The warmaster thought this an appropriate offer from the underling.<ref name="BP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong warrior appeared in [[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point|''Balance Point'']], a [[2000]] installment of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series by [[Kathy Tyers]].<ref name="BP" />
